$comment: Each target binds a skill invocation to a policy directory. Adding support for another third-party skill set is a data change: append an entry and create policy/<policy>/. match_prompt and match_skill are deliberately separate: a prompt is free text where a bare word like 'implement' appears constantly, while a skill name is a short controlled string.

targets.description: mattpocock-skills /implement — ticket worktree, --no-ff merge, ticket lifecycle
